logic.entry: Aggregate UTC daily high/low,last close and base volume over1440closed minutes. TP=(H+L+C)/3. Raw flow=TP*base_volume;assign to positive ifTP rises,negative ifTP falls,zero to both whenTP ties. Sum Nflows overj-N+1..j,using earlierTP atj-N. MFI=100*positive/(positive+negative);if total exactly0,set50. For exact thresholds use TP3=H+L+C,flow3=TP3*volume,which cancels the common3. Local Decimal60 flow arithmetic and cross-multiplied thresholds;accounting kernel remainsDecimal28. No seed/fold reset. When flat,enter iff MFI>entry_mfi_threshold;strict cross-multiplied comparison,no prior-cross requirement.
logic.exit: While long,exit iff MFI<45. Exact45and zero-flow-neutral50keep long;flat stays cash at or below entry threshold. No future padding,fold reset,short,hold cap or same-decision re-entry. Costed terminal liquidation.
logic.sizing: Independent 2,000 USDT cash account; all original capital allocated to this asset; long-only, no leverage, no borrowing, no cross-asset transfer or add-on.
logic.timing: Close-based signal only from a closed UTC daily bar, next day 00:01 UTC one-minute open (60-second delay); no historical fill before OOS.

parameters.impact_model: 0.5 * sample_stdev(previous 20 complete UTC daily log returns) * sqrt(order quote budget / previous 20 complete daily quote-volume ADV)
